decision: Individual engineer metrics (commit counts, PR counts, review speed per person, lines of code) are permanently excluded from DecisionDeck with no exceptions without an explicit superseding decision.
key_insight: Individual engineer metrics (commit counts, PR counts, review speed per person, lines of code) are permanently excluded from DecisionDeck with no exceptions without an explicit superseding decision.
alternatives_considered: Show per-engineer PR counts as an optional opt-in metric
rejected_reason: Individual metrics are easily misused for performance judgments based on weak signals
Contradicts the product principle: DecisionDeck improves systems, not scores individuals
